warnings.title: DELTA-INTRODUCED (W1 fold): a cap-locked attach ring starves SEED — an eligible estate whose every placeable ring tile sits in capped districts burns every window budget and growth stalls board-wide
warnings.evidence: coin < bias_prob_permille (default 1000 = EVERY attempt) with an eligible cluster exists -> ATTACH; SEED fires only with NO eligible cluster. Eligibility (has_room) checks E31-placeability but NOT cap-blockage of ring tiles; the drawn-tile cap check then rejects every draw -> GROWTH_MAX_ATTEMPTS (8) exhausts -> window skips; state unchanged -> stable forever.
warnings.detail: When every eligible estate's placeable ring lies in capped districts (reachable at 667-permille long runs as districts fill), districts UNDER cap with legal SEED placements receive nothing — permanent growth stall despite budget. No wrong state, no cap leak, determinism intact; the spec blesses the rejection semantics but not the eligibility gap.
warnings.recommended_fix: Mirror the drawn-tile cap into cluster eligibility (a ring with zero cap-admissible tiles makes the cluster ineligible -> SEED takes over), or document the stall as the designed bound-first behavior.
